name: Seated Pose with Raised Left Knee and Extended Right Leg
name_es: Pose sentada con rodilla izquierda elevada y pierna derecha extendida

pose_and_framing_block.base: Seated on both sit bones, with slight posterior pelvic tilt and slight rotation toward the subject's right. Weight distributed across the pelvis, with no weight borne by the feet.
pose_and_framing_block.left_leg: Marked hip and knee flexion (approximately 90–100 degrees). Thigh raised, shin nearly vertical; left foot planted flat on the ground in front of the torso, toes pointing forward.
pose_and_framing_block.right_leg: Extended toward the subject's right and slightly forward. Hip slightly to moderately flexed, knee slightly bent; right foot resting on its outer edge with the sole partially visible and toes pointing outward.
pose_and_framing_block.torso: Upright, with slight lateral lean toward the subject's right and slight torsion.
pose_and_framing_block.shoulders: Right shoulder lower and relaxed; left shoulder slightly advanced.
pose_and_framing_block.right_arm: Hanging beside the torso, elbow nearly fully extended with slight flexion. Right hand supported near the ground beside the right hip, fingers relaxed.
pose_and_framing_block.left_arm: Crosses toward the left leg, elbow moderately flexed, forearm resting across the thigh. Left hand resting on the left shin with fingers extended toward the ankle.
pose_and_framing_block.head: Facing forward, with a slight turn and lateral tilt toward the subject's right.

camera_and_style_block.camera_position: Front three-quarter view from the subject's left side.
camera_and_style_block.lens_height: Slightly above eye level, with a gentle downward camera angle.
camera_and_style_block.framing: Full body, from the crown of the head to both feet.
